user_query: trass workspace with term maker or tester

intent.goal: search for content in trass workspace containing maker or tester terms

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    COALESCE(g.subject, '') as subject,
    COALESCE(g.sender_name, '') as sender_name,
    COALESCE(g.sender_email, '') as sender_email,
    COALESCE(g.message_content, '') as message_content
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id 
LEFT JOIN generic_content gc ON u.page_id = gc.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name IN ('journal', 'stories', 'gmail', 'cpj', 'epics')
AND (
    LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%maker%' OR LOWER(u.title) LIKE '%tester%'
    OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%maker%' OR LOWER(g.subject) LIKE '%tester%'
    OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%maker%' OR LOWER(g.message_content) LIKE '%tester%'
    OR LOWER(gc.metadata) LIKE '%maker%' OR LOWER(gc.metadata) LIKE '%tester%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200
